sources.citation: Laidig, Wyn D. & Sahabu Dg. Maingak. 1999. Barang-barang phonology: a preliminary description. In Wyn D. Laidig (ed), Studies in Sulawesi linguistics part 6 (NUSA 46), 46-83. Jakarta: Universitas Katolik Indonesia Atma Jaya.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request); access check: online with a university library login
sources.note: Phonology is of BARANG-BARANG (sister language, 77% lexically similar): sec. 11 'Word stress', p.60: 'Word stress is normally penultimate. This applies to roots as well as derived forms', with antepenultimate stress in recent loans carrying an epenthetic echo-vowel -V? syllable. On Kalao itself, p.46: 'No published language data exists for Kalao'. Appendix A (pp.65-74) gives a 488-item Kalao wordlist with no stress marking (checked page image p-20).
